highlights: If + Past Simple, Would + V1
en: If we had more time, we would extend the deadline.
tr: Daha fazla vaktimiz olsaydı, teslim tarihini uzatırdık.
ipa: /ɪf wiː hæd mɔː taɪm wiː wʊd ɪkˈstɛnd ðə ˈdɛdlaɪn/
trPron: if vi hed mor taym vi vud ikstend dı dedlayn
tense: Second conditional kuralı gereği 'if' cümlesi Past Simple alır, ana cümle 'would' alır. 'Had' geçmişe değil, hayali şimdiki zamana aittir.
commonMistake: If we would have more time... ❌

highlights: If + Past Simple, Would + V1
en: If the budget were flexible, we would reallocate funds.
tr: Bütçe esnek olsaydı, fonları yeniden tahsis ederdik.
ipa: /ɪf ðə ˈbʌdʒɪt wɜːr ˈflɛksɪbl wiː wʊd ˌriːˈæləkeɪt fʌndz/
trPron: if dı bacit vör fleksibl vi vud riy-elıkeyt fandz
tense: Second Conditional
commonMistake: If the budget was flexible... (Correct but 'were' is standard) ❌
aiExplain: 'If I/he/she/it were' Second conditional için en doğru formdur. Bütçenin hayali esnekliği üzerine kuruludur.

highlights: If + Past Simple, Would + V1
en: If we had a vacancy, we would hire a new designer.
tr: Bir boşluğumuz olsaydı, yeni bir tasarımcı işe alırdık.
ipa: /ɪf wiː hæd ə ˈveɪkənsi wiː wʊd ˈhaɪər ə njuː dɪˈzaɪnə/
trPron: if vi hed e veykınsi vi vud hayır e nyu dizaynır
tense: Second Conditional
commonMistake: If we would have a vacancy... ❌
aiExplain: İşe alım sürecindeki hayali bir fırsatı Second Conditional ile belirtiriz. 'Had' fiili burada durumu tanımlar.

highlights: If + Past Perfect, Would have + V3
en: If the team had automated the process, they would have saved hours.
tr: Ekip süreci otomatize etseydi, saatlerce zaman kazanırdı.
ipa: /ɪf ðə tiːm hæd ˈɔːtəmeɪtɪd ðə ˈprəʊsɛs ðeɪ wʊd hæv seɪvd ˈaʊəz/
trPron: if dı tiym hed otomeytid dı pıroses dey vud hev seyvd avırz
tense: Third Conditional
commonMistake: If the team would have automated the process... ❌
aiExplain: Geçmişte yapılabilecek bir iyileştirmenin olası sonucunu Third Conditional kurgular. 'Had automated' zorunludur.

highlights: If + Past Perfect, Would have + V3
en: If the records had been complete, we would have passed the audit.
ipa: /ɪf ðə ˈrɛkɔːdz hæd biːn kəmˈpliːt wiː wʊd hæv pɑːst ði ˈɔːdɪt/
trPron: if dı rekords hed biyn kompliyt vi vud hev paast di odit
tense: 'If'li kısımda 'would' kullanımı hatalıdır. 'Had been complete' geçmişteki durumun (Past Perfect) şartıdır.
commonMistake: If the records would have been complete... ❌

highlights: If + Past Perfect, Would have + V3
en: If the government had signed the pact, trade would have increased.

trPron: if dı gavırnmınt hed saynd dı pekt tıreyd vud hev inkriyst
tense: Ticari bir kararın (anlaşma) gerçekleşmemiş etkilerini Third Conditional (Past Perfect + Would have) analiz eder.
collocations: trade pact document legal stamp signing
commonMistake: If the government would have signed... ❌

highlights: If + Past Simple, Would + V1
en: If we charged lower prices, we would attract more clients.

tense: Second Conditional
commonMistake: If we would charge lower prices... ❌

highlights: If + Past Simple, Would + V1
en: If the meeting were in the office, the team would attend.

highlights: If + Past Perfect, Would have + V3
en: If the staff had checked the labels, they would not have mislabeled.

commonMistake: If the staff would have checked... ❌

highlights: If + Past Perfect, Would have + V3

highlights: If + Past Simple, Would + V1

highlights: If + Past Perfect, Would have + V3
